title: Your IdP → our resource AS
lede: An outside agent signs its user in at its own IdP and gets an ID-JAG addressed to our authorization server. You paste it here, or tools/outside-agent.js presents it directly. Or click "Get an ID-JAG from xaa.dev": IdenX, the IdP of Okta's free xaa.dev playground, signs you in and issues one to this server. Our authorization server only trusts an outside IdP because an admin approved it on the Trusted IdPs registry.

steps.title: Paste an ID-JAG, or get one from xaa.dev
steps.what: Your IdP signs its user in and issues the ID-JAG (aud = our authorization server's issuer). You paste it; the server keeps it and shows only its decoded claims. Or use xaa.dev: this server signs you in at IdenX (code + PKCE), exchanges IdenX's refresh token for an ID-JAG addressed to resource-as's public issuer, and loads it the same way.
steps.why: tools/outside-agent.js runs the same flow with none of our code in its path: its IdP, then our public token endpoint, then (optionally) the MCP server.

steps.title: Check it against the draft
steps.what: The server finds the issuer on the Trusted IdPs registry (enabled, and targeting the server you picked), verifies the signature with that IdP's JWKS, and runs the draft checks.
steps.why: Trust comes from the Trusted IdPs registry: an admin approves the issuer, its JWKS URL, the client_id it writes and the targets. An issuer not on the list (or not for this target) is refused before any redemption.

steps.title: Redeem at our resource AS
steps.what: RFC 7523 JWT bearer grant at resource-as (client from the registry entry) or at our PingFederate (PF_REDEEMER_CLIENT_ID). resource-as reads the registry from this server; PingFederate gets it as an IdP connection from the sync script. Either one verifies against the outside IdP's keys and mints its own token. For IdenX: keys at idp.xaa.dev/jwks, and its client_id must be the one its entry maps to idp-<id>.
steps.why: Trust comes from the Trusted IdPs registry: an admin approves the issuer, its JWKS URL, the client_id it writes and the targets. An issuer not on the list (or not for this target) is refused before any redemption.

steps.title: Call mcp-sample
steps.what: tools/list and tools/call go straight to mcp-sample with resource-as's token; mcp-sample verifies it against resource-as's JWKS. The protected page takes the same token. (A token from our PingFederate is refused there: mcp-sample trusts resource-as only.)

steps.title: Negative tests
steps.what: We cannot mint at your IdP, so each test reuses your pasted ID-JAG and breaks one thing. Replay is skipped.
steps.why: Replay is skipped: it would use up your ID-JAG. The other tests reuse your pasted token, broken one way at a time.
